title: Chibi town: pixel art from simple 3D
about: A handheld-RPG look: 480 × 270, a camera straight on and 45° down so a metre is 16 px on the ground and up a wall, one palette, inked outlines. People are pixel sprites drawn from templates in three views and shaded like a pixel artist (samples/lib/sprites.js), stood in the street as upright cards, 8 frames a second. Trees and props are sprites too (samples/lib/townsprites.js); facades, signs and the ground are painted textures on boxes (samples/lib/pixeltown.js). Night lights the windows, signs and lamps.
